rationales.authenticity: 'Her waters break,' 'pains come strong and regular,' and the understanding that first labor may be long are all historically accurate obstetric knowledge.
rationales.character: Brigid's confident, direct voice as an experienced midwife is evident; her matter-of-fact advice reflects the authority of a woman who has delivered many births.
rationales.craft: Well-structured in 2-4 sentences; concise, informative, and evocative of Brigid's expertise without unnecessary elaboration.
rationales.language: Clear, well-formed Irish English prose with period-appropriate syntax and vocabulary, no non-Latin script.
rationales.responsiveness: Comprehensively addresses the when-to-fetch-me prompt with practical labor signs, timing wisdom, and explicit instructions.
